features.label: Survives in fragments
features.detail: About a hundred sentences, no complete work. Everything beyond that is reconstruction and educated guessing.

features.label: Called obscure in antiquity
features.detail: He was deliberately difficult 2,500 years ago. Modern confusion is not a translation problem.

features.label: Change as the only constant
features.detail: Not a slogan. A claim that stability itself is the illusion, which is far stranger than the poster version.
